LESSON: AFRICAN TRADITIONAL EDUCATION

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade five
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: People and Social Organizations 2
Topic 2.3: African traditional Education
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 4

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers African traditional Education, part of People and Social Organizations 2 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade five SOCIAL STUDIES.

Key inquiry question: How does African traditional education promote values in our community? 2. How was education conducted in the traditional African societies?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

or listen to and observe narratives, stories on aspects of African traditional education.

• Citizenship: participate in the community and contribute to a better world through informed, ethical and peaceful action as learners

give a summary of an aspect of African traditional education and share the information in class.
